Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 📦.

JACK:
I don't want it! I don't need it! It's just a bunch of chemicals to control my mind 💥.

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you know the risks. You know it's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕.

JACK:
I refuse! I won't take it! (stands up and starts to pace around the room) You don't understand me! You don't know what it's like to be me! 🌪️

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, stop this. You're not listening to me 🗣️.

JACK:
(outraged) I am listening! I'm listening to the voices in my head! And they're telling me to make you take the pills! 💬

DR. SMITH:
(skeptical) Jack, that's not possible. You're not hearing voices 🙅‍♂️.

JACK:
(eyes flashing) Oh, but I am! And I'm going to make you take them! (grabs Dr. Smith's arm and starts to pull him towards the medicine cabinet) Come on, doc! Let's get this over with! 💪

DR. SMITH:
(resisting) Jack, stop! You're not going to make me do anything! (tries to shake off Jack's grip) Let go of me! 🚫

Jack's grip is surprisingly strong, and Dr. Smith finds himself being pulled towards the medicine cabinet 🚪. He opens the cabinet and pulls out a bottle of pills, his eyes fixed on Jack's determined face 👀.

DR. SMITH:
(muttering) Fine... (pours two pills into his hand) Here you go, Jack... (hands the pills to Jack, who takes them and swallows them down 💊)

As Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he's met with an empty space where Jack was sitting 🤔. The room is quiet, except for the sound of his own breathing 👂.

DR. SMITH:
(confused) Where...where is Jack? 🤷‍♂️

He looks around the room, but there's no sign of his patient or his own reflection in the mirror 📸. Suddenly, it hits him - the voices, the delusions, the pills...it was all just a product of his own fractured mind 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) Oh no...oh no, no, no... 🙏

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror, and the screen fades to black 🎥.
